faces.name: Cola Bottling Plant
faces.oracleText:
When you planeswalk here and whenever a land you control enters, bottle the top card of your library. (Exile it. You may play it this turn.)
Whenever chaos ensues and when you planeswalk away from here, each player puts each bottled card they own into their graveyard and creates that many 1/1 green Plant creature tokens.
